entities.name: Cave Art as Collective Ritual
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Lascaux, Altamira, and Chauvet caves were not homes — they were ritual spaces. Hand stencils, animal paintings, and geometric symbols were created by firelight in inaccessible chambers. Evidence suggests initiation ceremonies, shamanic trances, and collective rituals.
